g.text: Runs in the background after a save.
Proposes up to 5 links, each with a score
and a one-line reason. Only the user's own
notes are candidates. An LLM failure never
blocks saving the note; the job is retried.
The answer cites the notes it used.
If no relevant note exists, the agent
says so rather than answering from
Every use case of the registered
